tabs.tab2_heading: Who should wear the Yellow Sapphire gemstone?
tabs.tab1_description:
Yellow Sapphire gemstone is a captivating gemstone with a variety of extraordinary properties. It is most famous for its stunning color, a vivid and enchanting shade of golden yellow. This gemstone is a corundum variety, the same mineral family as rubies and sapphires, and it is distinguished by its exceptional hardness, making it not only a captivating adornment but also a durable one suitable for everyday wear.

This prestigious stone is composed of corundum (aluminum oxide) and is tinted yellow by minute traces of iron, which gives it its natural appearance. Typically, the gem is found in igneous rocks and alluvial deposits. Peela Pukhraj is a 9 on the Mohs scale, making it an extremely hard stone that cannot even be scratched by steel; only diamond can do so.

Yellow Sapphire is believed to improve mental clarity, focus, and creativity, making it an excellent choice for students, artists, and people looking to improve their intellectual pursuits. Furthermore, Yellow Sapphire is associated with wealth and prosperity. It is said to attract wealth and financial opportunities, making it a popular choice for those looking to start a business or improve their financial situation. It is also well-known for bringing positivity, joy, and happiness into the wearer's life, thereby reducing stress and anxiety.

Yellow Sapphire is associated with Jupiter, the planet known as the 'Guru' or teacher in Vedic astrology. Wearing this gem is said to increase Jupiter's influence in one's birth chart, resulting in greater wisdom, spiritual growth, and favorable life circumstances. It is a stone of wisdom, knowledge, power, good fortune, creative ideas, putting the plan into action, letting go of fear and procrastination. The healing properties of the Yellow Sapphire are admired worldwide. It brings balance to the Vishuddha Chakra.

This amazing sunset yellow color gemstone has long held the admiration and wonder of all kinds of people, from travelers and explorers to Kings and Queens. Natural Yellow Sapphire stone has been used by Priests, Spiritual counsellors and Gurus, and healers in India since ancient times because it aids in connection with the spiritual realm.

In conclusion, Yellow Sapphire combines its enticing beauty with the potential to bring clarity, abundance, and positivity into the lives of those who embrace its enchantment.

tabs.tab2_description:
Although a Yellow Sapphire can be worn by anyone for its tremendous benefits, it is recommended that an astro and chakra expert consultation is sought before wearing Yellow Sapphire. In Chakra science, it helps open and balance the Throat Chakra. Thus, it is highly recommended for those looking for relief from stress, peace of mind and calmness. 

Students and researchers in any field can benefit from wearing Yellow Sapphire because Jupiter bestows knowledge and intellect while also assisting with focus and concentration. This stone can be worn by teachers, lawyers, judges, advocates, writers, authors, artists, and traders.

If Jupiter is weak in your birth chart (Kundli), you can certainly wear it after consulting a qualified astrologer. For a harmonious marriage, yellow sapphire is highly recommended for married women to wear. Yellow Sapphire gemstone may be worn by anyone pursuing a higher education. Also, counselors, healers, and mystics can wear yellow sapphires for support and enhanced spiritual growth.

Important Details:  

Note that one should only wear natural, unheated, untreated Yellow Sapphire gemstones so they can experience healing and empowerment. Rudra Centre only deals in 100% natural, unheated, untreated Yellow Sapphire gemstones.  

Yellow Sapphire Buying Guide

Check its Origin:

Yellow sapphires are found in Sri Lanka (formerly Ceylon), where they are known for their exceptional clarity and vibrant yellow hues, and are considered the best. Other important sources include Madagascar, Thailand, and Queensland in Australia, which produces yellow sapphires in alluvial deposits. Myanmar in Burma has historically been a source of high-quality yellow sapphires, and India has some yellow sapphire deposits as well.

Observe their Color:

Sri Lanka yellow sapphires display a pure, vibrant yellow color. The clarity and brilliance of Ceylon Yellow sapphires are extremely valuable. A highly saturated and intense yellow is preferred over a pale or washed-out color. The tone of the yellow sapphire should ideally be in the medium to medium-dark range, as stones that are too light may lack brilliance, while stones that are too dark may appear overly opaque.

Notice their Clarity:

Yellow Sapphire clarity can range from virtually flawless gemstones with no visible inclusions to those with minor flaws. These include tiny mineral crystals, fractures, or other natural features. Gemstones that are "eye-clean," or have no visible inclusions to the naked eye, are highly valued for their exceptional clarity and transparency, which allows the gem's vibrant yellow color to shine brightly.

Examine their Inclusions:

Some Yellow Sapphires are relatively free of inclusions and appear transparent to the naked eye, whereas others may contain inclusions of varying size and type. These inclusions are exclusive to each gemstone and can affect its overall appearance, transparency, and value.

See their Shape:

Yellow Sapphires are masterfully crafted in a variety of shapes, from the classic and timeless elegance of round and oval cuts to the soft allure of cushion and pear shapes, each of which accentuates the gem's vibrant golden hue in its own unique way. Princess and emerald cuts have a modern and geometric appeal, while heart-shaped Yellow Sapphires have a romantic appeal.

Check the Carats:

For Yellow Sapphire of gem quality, the raw Yellow Sapphire is divided and polished into smaller stones of variable carat weight. In general, Yellow Sapphire weighing 5 carats is appropriate for jewelry. Because Yellow Sapphire is sold by weight, Yellow Sapphire prices are calculated per carat. Stones of comparable dimensions but distinct varieties vary greatly in price. The more carats and clarity Yellow Sapphire has, the higher its price.

Avoid Heated & Treated Yellow Sapphire:

Due to treatments the Yellow Sapphire stone loses its natural composition and thus loses its natural frequency. These heated and treated Yellow Sapphire do not offer any healing benefits and should be avoided.

Check for Lab Certificate:

It is recommended that you should purchase Yellow Sapphire gemstones along a lab tested certificate which can determine its authenticity, treatment status and origin. Rudra Centre has been dealing in natural unheated untreated lab certified gemstones for the past 25 years. Our Yellow Sapphires are certified from trusted labs like GIA, IGI, GLI and IGITL.

Why buy Yellow Sapphire from Rudra Centre?

We only deal with untreated and unheated gemstones from their natural sources, which we energize in accordance with Vedic Vidhi, after more than 20 years of research and 100.000+ satisfied, healed, and empowered customers.

Can I give my used Yellow Sapphire gemstone to someone else?

You should avoid it if you are wearing it. However, if you have not used it for an extended period, you can pass it on to someone else. It is recommended to not wear it for at least 2 weeks before giving it to someone else. You can also follow the cleansing and reenergizing process mentioned in the benefits section.

tabs.tab4_description:
For the best results it is highly recommended that one wears only 100% natural, unheated, and untreated Yellow Sapphire gemstones. As per the Vedic scriptures, a heat treatment harms its sattvic nature, rendering the stone less effective and beneficial. Like other gemstones, the quality of Yellow Sapphire is also determined by the four Cs (Color, Cut, Carat, Clarity).  

Color 

Yellow sapphires can be opaque in accordance with how deep the yellow color is and is characterized by various shades from Yellow to Golden to sometimes Orange as well. However, the Lemon yellow color is considered the best. 

Cut 

The best quality yellow sapphires have cuts that maximize the effect of hue, tone, and saturation. The round and oval cuts are classic and timeless, maximizing brilliance and highlighting the gemstone vibrant golden hue, while the cushion cut adds softness and charm.

Carat 

Yellow Sapphire of 5 carats and above is the most sought-after for harnessing its beauty and properties, but significantly smaller and larger gems are used in contemporary jewelry. Generally, the price of a yellow sapphire rises as the size/weight/carat increases.

Clarity 

For the clarity of a yellow sapphire, the size, quantity, and overall appearance of inclusions are key factors. Like other precious stones, yellow sapphires do contain some inclusions visible. Those with no inclusions to the unaided eye are super-rare and valuable. Thus, the yellow sapphires with some inclusions are accepted as well. Yellow sapphires with the least inclusions and best clarity are considered the best.

Traders deal in Yellow Sapphires which are synthetic to natural but which are treated/heated and color enhanced, so it is immensely important to purchase only from a reputed dealer with certification from a reputed lab.       

Yellow Sapphire Gemstone Price  

Yellow Sapphire price can change a lot depending on the size of the gem, which is measured in carats, and the color of the gem is a very important factor in pricing. A bright, pure canary yellow color is very popular and can fetch a high price. Clarity is a very valuable factor. Gemstones with few or no visible flaws are often more expensive because their clarity is better. 

Yellow Sapphire stone price also depends on its source. For example, stones from well-known places like Sri Lanka (Ceylon) usually sell for more because of their reputation for quality. Pukhraj stone price in India is more affordable than other sources even if more rarely found. Additionally, the cost of Yellow Sapphire can be affected by how it was cut, its overall quality, and any certifications it has from reputable gemological laboratories.

Common treatments have a significant impact on the price of Yellow Sapphire and value but are rarely discussed. The overwhelming majority of Yellow Sapphires are treated with oil or resin fillers to improve their clarity. In the gemstones market as a whole, untreated Yellow Sapphires of significant size and weight that have not been treated are a rarity. 

However, you should prefer untreated Yellow Sapphires to reap the benefits of their numerous beneficial properties. When a gemstone is heat-treated or undergoes the dying process, its healing properties are lost when it is worn. Yellow Sapphire has numerous curative properties; to maximize its healing effects, only untreated Yellow Sapphire stone should be worn.

The price of genuine, natural and unheated, untreated Yellow Sapphire gemstones at Rudra Centre ranges from INR 26,400 to INR 3,74,090 (USD 324 to USD 4.601). This is the original pukhraj stone price for a wide range of Yellow Sapphires in a variety of carats.

How to Identify or Test Original & Authentic Yellow Sapphire?

The best way to check the authenticity of Yellow Sapphire is by getting a Lab tested report from a reputed laboratory. Rudra Centre only deals with Vedic Astrology approved gemstones that are natural, untreated, and unheated. All our Yellow Sapphires are certified by reputable labs like GIA, GLI, IGI and IGITL.

Look for flaws along with inclusions. Use a magnifying glass with at least 10x magnification to examine the Yellow Sapphire carefully. Look for specks and blemishes, as they form with minute particles of other material. These flaws are strong evidence that a Yellow Sapphire is genuine. Lab-created (fake) Yellow Sapphires have no inclusions of this nature, and neither do natural Yellow Sapphires, but if you find flaws, then your Yellow Sapphire is genuine.

Examine the gemstone for air bubbles. Essentially, lab-created Yellow Sapphires are glass that has undergone a process similar to that which forms natural Yellow Sapphire. Since they are made of glass, they retain miniscule air bubbles after formation. If there are bubbles within the Yellow Sapphire, it is not genuine. Be sure to inspect your Yellow Sapphire from every angle by turning it over. There is a possibility that bubbles of air will only be evident from a single angle.

Look at how light is reflected by the Yellow Sapphire. Turn off all the lights and shine your flashlight on the Yellow Sapphire. If it is genuine, it will only reflect light of the same hue as itself. If it is a fake, made of glass, it will reflect colors other than the natural color of the gem.

Yellow Sapphire Cleaning & Maintenance

Submerge the Yellow Sapphire in soapy water and scrub away any dirt with a soft brush, such as a toothbrush. Remove any soap residue from the gem by rinsing it under warm, running water. Use a clean, lint-free cloth to pat it dry, or allow it to air dry. 

You should avoid using harsh chemicals, ultrasonic cleaners, and steam cleaners on the gemstone, as they may cause damage. 

Regular cleaning will help preserve your Yellow Sapphire's brilliance and keep it looking its best.
